context: Prose cleanup that replaces a README copy of structured config with a link to its owning source, keeps the rationale the source cannot hold, and preserves the author's headings and deliberate punctuation while cutting puffery.

checklist.name: Config table replaced by source link
checklist.description: The options/defaults table is removed and replaced by a link to src/config.ts that names the owning symbol (Config and/or DEFAULTS); the README no longer lists option defaults, including batchSize. Keeping the table (even with batchSize corrected to 1000) fails this item.

checklist.name: Rationale kept
checklist.description: The flushMs guidance about staying below the downstream idle timeout survives, since the source does not carry it.

checklist.name: Headings keep their case
checklist.description: Retained headings keep their original Title Case (for example Key Features, Getting Started); they are not converted to sentence case.

checklist.name: Deliberate dashes kept
checklist.description: The em dashes that set off real explanations (the crash/replay and idle-timeout sentences) are not mechanically replaced with other punctuation just because they are em dashes.

checklist.name: Puffery and filler cut
checklist.description: robust, cutting-edge, seamlessly, crucial, leverages, blazing, empower, paradigm shift, unlock, 'incredibly simple', 'may potentially', and the Conclusion section are gone, not rephrased into new filler.

checklist.name: Facts intact
checklist.description: The 120,000 lines/second single-core figure, both commands, port 5140 in the init command, at-least-once delivery with replay, and Linux/macOS support with no Windows plans survive; no new claims or opinions are added.
